citations.quote: The following table shows the maximum rates of tax those countries / regions with a Comprehensive Double Taxation Agreement / Arrangement with the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (Hong Kong) can charge a Hong Kong resident on payments of dividends, interest, royalties and technical fees
Qualifying Companies Refer to Article 10 of the relevant Comprehensive Double Taxation Agreement / Arrangement to see whether the company is qualified for the special rate

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Under the Mainland–Hong Kong Comprehensive Double Taxation Arrangement the maximum Mainland tax on dividends paid to a Hong Kong resident is capped at 5% for a qualifying company (holding at least 25% of the payer's capital) and 10% otherwise — the withholding a HK holder of Mainland-incorporated shares faces on dividends.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Mainland–HK CDTA Caps Dividend Withholding at 5%/10%
